_about: The one source for the resume (resume.html, the PDF, mkskitka.com/resume) and the CV (cv.html). Edit here or with npm run resume:edit, then npm run resume:build. *text* is italic.
name: Mary Kate Skitka
title: Creative Technologist, Developer & Educator

profile.resume: Creative technologist, developer and educator with over 8 years of experience building generative and interactive media, from initial ideation through deployment. Most recently built PGN, a multi-room interactive rehabilitation system that runs body and eye tracking, depth cameras and lidar through a single TouchDesigner system, now installed at clinical sites. Earlier work includes a real-time generative AI visuals system for an installation at the Venice Biennale '24, and four years building visualization tools for AI research. Has taught courses and workshops in creative technology at NYU.
profile.cv: Creative technologist, developer and educator working in generative and interactive media: real-time visual systems for installations, live performance and clinical environments, from concept through on-site commissioning. Practice runs on two tracks, visuals and systems: generative, environment-aware content built in TouchDesigner, ComfyUI and Three.js, and the sensing, display and software architecture that ties it to a space. Teaches creative technology at NYU and performs and exhibits in New York City as rgb__tears.
